Name: Mechanics 3 Project
Description: Collaborated with a team to analyse the structural behaviour of a sheltered walkway by identifying and calculating the different stresses and forces acting on its structural components. Applied engineering mechanics concepts such as axial stress, shear stress, bending stress, principal stress, and strain to evaluate the structural integrity and stability of the walkway. The project provided practical insight into how structures are designed to withstand various loading conditions while maintaining safety and stability in real-world applications. Took a leading role within the team by coordinating tasks, facilitating discussions, and ensuring effective collaboration throughout the project, strengthening my leadership, teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Name: Cornerstone Project
Description: Collaborated with a team to design, construct, and test a functional glider, applying fundamental principles of aerodynamics, aircraft stability, structural design, and weight optimisation. Contributed to the design process by evaluating the glider’s aerodynamic performance and structural requirements to improve flight efficiency and stability. The project provided hands-on experience in translating theoretical engineering concepts into a physical aircraft while developing teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and project management skills.

Name: Singapore Polytechnic Open House (SPOH)
Description: Served as a student guide during the Singapore Polytechnic Open House, welcoming and guiding prospective students and visitors around the campus. Introduced visitors to different facilities and areas within Singapore Polytechnic, with a particular focus on the Engineering Block, while explaining the learning environment, facilities, and student experience. Developed my communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills by engaging with visitors from different backgrounds and confidently answering questions to help them gain a better understanding of life and studies at SP.
